baseline_models.focus_anchor: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا coordinates two accusative verbal nouns with أَوْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first noun opens the social-forensic possibility of excuse, apology, or removal of blame; the second performs warning by awakening fear and caution. The construction holds these as alternative effects of one unstated act.

activation_trace.role: Claiming or receiving excuse supplies the blame-removing side of the pair.
Fear-awakening warning supplies the caution-producing side of the pair.

changed_reading.before: Two compact nouns flattened into a general statement of admonition.
changed_reading.after: A deliberate two-way communicative result: a route out of blame or an alert that makes danger actionable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عُذْرًا and نُذْرًا can be joined through the focus branches for going far enough to be excused and for effective warning.
baseline_models.mechanism: Adequate warning can itself be the act by which a communicator reaches the threshold of being excused. The pair permits a liability-transfer reading: notice discharges the notifier while placing cautionary responsibility on the notified.

activation_trace.role: Going far enough to be excused supplies a threshold of completed notice.
A warning that produces caution supplies the act completing that threshold.

changed_reading.before: Excuse belongs only to a recipient pleading for release, while warning is separate.
changed_reading.after: The warning may complete the notifier's obligation and shift responsibility to its recipient.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding participial sequence becomes a delivery pipeline: dispatch in ordered succession, forceful movement, spreading, distinguishing, and finally casting a reminder. The focus pair names the pipeline's terminal functions, either establishing excuse or delivering warning.

activation_trace.role: Excuse and removal of blame supply one terminal function of the reminder.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the other terminal function.
Dispatch and outward movement initiate the delivery process.
Continuous succession gives the dispatched movement an ordered sequence.
Speed and forceful movement intensify transmission through the sequence.
Opening and spreading expand what is being carried.
Distinguishing two things prepares the focus pair's functional bifurcation.
Casting or placing something supplies the final delivery action.
A reminder that makes one remember identifies the delivered content.

structural_cues: 77:1-5 is a linked participial sequence whose final member casts remembrance immediately before 77:6.
Repeated cognate accusatives in 77:1-5 culminate in the coordinated accusatives of 77:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch, succession, force, spreading, distinction, casting, and reminder; I connect them as stages whose output is 77:6. A live alternative is that they are parallel descriptions and the focus pair gives only a shared purpose.

changed_reading.before: A self-contained alternative between excuse and warning.
changed_reading.after: The designed output of an ordered transmission process that spreads and distinguishes remembrance until it can exculpate or warn.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning is tied to a threatened promise that will become fixed reality, while messengers, deadline, and adjudication are explicitly timed. This makes the notice advance procedural notice of a bounded event rather than undirected alarm.

activation_trace.role: Going far enough to be excused supplies the completed-notice threshold.
Fear-awakening warning supplies advance notice of the threatened event.
A threat concerning harm specifies the warning's prospective content.
Falling and becoming fixed turns the warned future into assured occurrence.
Bounding something by a time or endpoint makes the process formally scheduled.
A fixed temporal limit supplies the deadline before which notice operates.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the proceeding's endpoint.

structural_cues: 77:7 immediately follows the focus and asserts that what is promised will occur.
77:11-13 move from messengers being timed, through a deferred limit, to a day of decision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies threat, assured occurrence, appointment, deadline, and adjudication; I infer that advance warning discharges a notice obligation before judgment. A live alternative is a purely chronological sequence with no liability transfer.

changed_reading.before: A warning that simply creates present fear.
changed_reading.after: Advance notice of a fixed adjudicative event, sufficient to complete the notifier's side of accountability before its deadline.

context_deltas.mechanism: The distant recurrence reverses the focus's apparent availability of excuse: on the later day, speech is negated and permission to apologize is withheld. The focus becomes a pre-judgment window in which grounds can be established or warning heeded before excuse-making is no longer authorized.

activation_trace.role: Excuse, apology, and removal of blame supply the possibility later denied.
Warning supplies the actionable notice available before the later closure.
Speech itself is the capacity negated in the later scene.
Permission and authorization identify the procedural access withheld.
The act of apologizing repeats the focus root in the prohibited position.

structural_cues: The exact focus root ع ذ ر recurs verbally at 77:36.
77:35-36 negate both speech and authorization before the gathered day-of-decision scene at 77:38.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated speech, denied permission, and attempted apology; I infer an earlier-versus-later contrast with the focus. A live alternative is that 77:36 describes only the later scene and does not define 77:6 as an offered excuse window.

changed_reading.before: Excuse and warning as timeless alternative labels.
changed_reading.after: A pre-decision economy of accountability: grounds or caution can matter now, whereas post-decision apology has neither speech nor license.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated attribution of falsehood and the closing question about what discourse can produce belief shift the pair from two speaker intentions toward two reception effects. Trusted remembrance can establish blame-removing grounds; rejected remembrance remains an unheeded warning that closes rather than opens excuse.

activation_trace.role: Removal of blame supplies the receptive, exculpatory possibility.
Warning that should awaken caution supplies the rejected possibility.
Attributing falsehood supplies the repeated resistant response.
Renewed speech or news identifies a communicative event awaiting uptake.
Heart-settling assent supplies the reception contrasted with denial.

structural_cues: The denial refrain recurs after successive argumentative and judgment scenes across the surah.
The final ayah asks what discourse after this one could receive belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated denial and a final discourse-belief question; I assign reception a role in deciding which side of the focus pair becomes operative. A live alternative is that both nouns describe the dispatcher's purpose regardless of response.

changed_reading.before: Two alternative purposes fixed entirely on the sending side.
changed_reading.after: A reception-sensitive fork: trusted reminder may establish grounds, while declared-false reminder persists as warning and removes the later shelter of denial.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a material rather than forensic branch of ع ذ ر; it remains anchored because the focus inventory explicitly supplies fading or erased traces and 77:8 and 77:10 repeat effacement and removal. Render it only as a secondary imagistic resonance, not as a replacement lexical translation of عُذْرًا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus occurrence عُذْرًا through its branch of traces fading, being cut off, or erased.

activation_trace.role: Fading and erasure of traces supply the branch-distant material anchor.
Warning supplies advance notice before the imagined erasure occurs.
Wiping away a trace directly reactivates the focus root's erasure image.
Uprooting and removal extend erasure from lights to landmarks.

changed_reading.before: عُذْرًا refers only to interpersonal or forensic excuse.
changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, removal of blame is materialized as removal of traces before a warning about lights and landmarks being erased.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the local ن ذ ر reading is naturally warning, while the inventory also preserves a self-binding vow branch. It remains anchored in focus نُذْرًا and is activated by promise, appointment, and deadline; render it only as an obligation-and-fulfillment undertone, not as the primary sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus occurrence نُذْرًا through the self-binding undertaking branch, paired with the excuse threshold in عُذْرًا.

activation_trace.role: Doing enough to be excused supplies release after completed obligation.
A self-binding vow supplies the opposite movement of assuming obligation.
A promise bounded by time or place supplies commitment awaiting fulfillment.
Fixing a time or endpoint gives the commitment a formal bound.
The appointed limit supplies the point at which commitment becomes fulfillment.

changed_reading.before: A binary of excuse and warning.
changed_reading.after: A faint juridical undertone of release after sufficient performance versus self-binding commitment carried to appointed fulfillment.

strongest_changes: The opening sequence turns the pair into the terminal function of an ordered reminder-delivery process.
Promise, fixed occurrence, timing, deadline, and adjudication turn warning into advance procedural notice that can discharge responsibility.
The denial of speech and permission to apologize at 77:35-36 makes the focus a pre-judgment opportunity whose later counterpart is closed.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet supplied both a precise late lexical reversal of ع ذ ر and distant material erasure imagery, allowing a strong accountability model to coexist with a contained branch-distant resonance.
remaining_uncertainties: The unstated governor and agent of the focus accusatives leave purpose, result, and speech-content construals open.
أَوْ may mark alternative functions, alternative recipients or outcomes, or a rhetorically inclusive pair.
The erasure and vow activations are traceable branch resonances, but the packet does not establish them as primary senses here.
